Built 2026-11-06T15:47:37-06:00, read-only. 25 cards: every well whose vendor-default sub-bench v5.1 changes by depth. Each card decides only its own well. The unit is never changed. A card whose plain-median check disagrees is marked, not dropped. Mark cards_sample.csv: agree / reject (keep the v5 code) / a bench code / free text (a hold). Nothing is applied.
